edges.reason: block.timestamp is consumed by random() as part of the pseudo-random seed, making it predictable and timestamp-dependent.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 randomness expression together with block.difficulty.
msg.sender is compared against ecozContract to authorise jagRandomizer.
msg.sender is compared against ecozContract to authorise jaguarTokenURI.
_msgSender() simply returns the caller msg.sender.
_msgSender() is compared to owner() inside the onlyOwner require.
owner() is the other operand of the onlyOwner require.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner restricts who may call transferOwnership.
onlyOwner restricts who may repoint the trusted ecozContract.
onlyOwner restricts who may reveal the collection.
transferOwnership delegates the actual write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership delegates the actual write to _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
jagRandomizer calls random() once per trait iteration.
jagRandomizer calls traitGenerator() to map randomness to a trait index.
random() increments and wraps the randI state counter.
randI is read back into the keccak256 seed, but is attacker-influenceable only via call ordering.
random() computes the weak keccak256 randomness expression.
ecozContract supplies the expected caller address for the jagRandomizer gate.
ecozContract supplies the expected caller address for the jaguarTokenURI gate.
jagRandomizer appends trait digits into jagIDToHash for the token.
jaguarTokenURI reads jagIDToHash to recover trait indices.
traitTypeCount is read to bound modulo arithmetic in the adult branch.
babyTraitTypeCount is read in the baby branch.
traitCount bounds the adult trait loop.
babyTraitCount bounds the baby trait loop.
Base64.encode executes the inline assembly memory-writing block.
Base64.decode executes the inline assembly decoding block.
Library.encode executes the inline assembly encoding block.
clearTraitType performs the unbounded delete of traitTypes[index].
clearBabyTraitType performs the unbounded delete of babyTraitTypes[index].
clearTraitType clears the traitTypes mapping entry and resets the count.
addJagTraitType pushes new Trait structs into traitTypes.
addBabyJagTraitType pushes new Trait structs into babyTraitTypes.
traitTypeCount is accumulated with traits.length, and could desynchronise from the actual array length.
babyTraitTypeCount is accumulated with traits.length and can desynchronise from the array.
setJagEcoz assigns the trusted ecozContract address.
reveal flips the revealed state flag.
setJagLegendary writes the Leg pixel strings.
setJagColorsLETTERS writes the Colors array.
setJagColorsLETTERS writes the LETTERS array.
letterToNumber scans LETTERS to resolve a letter to an index.
letterToColor scans LETTERS before returning the matching color.
jaguarTokenURI calls Library.substring to slice pixel codes.
jaguarTokenURI calls Library.toString to build metadata text.
jaguarTokenURI calls Library.parseInt on the stored trait hash.
jaguarTokenURI calls Base64.encode for the final data URI.
jaguarTokenURI calls Library.encode for the SVG payload.
jaguarTokenURI converts pixel letters to coordinates via letterToNumber.
jaguarTokenURI converts pixel letters to colors via letterToColor.
jaguarTokenURI reads adult trait metadata and pixel strings.
jaguarTokenURI reads baby trait metadata and pixel strings.
jaguarTokenURI reads Leg for unrevealed and legendary rendering.
the revealed flag selects the unrevealed rendering branch.
the data parameter is the encoded byte payload.
the _data parameter is the base64 string being decoded.
the value parameter is converted to a decimal string.
the _a parameter is parsed digit by digit into a uint8.
the str parameter is the string being sliced.
startIndex controls the slice start, unchecked against str length.
endIndex controls the slice end and the output buffer size.
thisTraitCount is the modulo bound in traitGenerator.
traitProbability chooses the rarity branch in traitGenerator.
the user parameter is forwarded to random() per trait.
the jagID parameter selects generation branch and indexes jagIDToHash.
the user parameter is mixed into the keccak256 seed.
the jagID parameter is mixed into the keccak256 seed.
the input letter is hashed and compared against LETTERS entries.
jagID branches the URI logic and indexes the trait storage.
jagWeight is embedded directly into the metadata attributes.
leg1 is stored into Leg[0] by the owner.
ecozAddress is cast to IEcoz and stored as the trusted caller.
newOwner becomes the new _owner through transferOwnership.
_traitTypeIndex selects which traitTypes entry is appended.
the traits array is iterated and pushed into storage.
index selects which traitTypes entry is deleted.
thisTrait holds the computed trait index returned by traitGenerator.
rand holds the random() result used for each trait.
thisTraitIndex is the parsed trait index used to read storage.
encodedLen sizes the output string and is written by the assembly block.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter data is the byte payload of Base64.encode and has no independent identity.
Parameter _data is the input of Base64.decode and has no independent identity.
Parameter value is the sole input to Library.toString.
Parameter _a is the sole input to Library.parseInt.
Parameter str is the source string of Library.substring.
Parameter startIndex only controls the slice performed by Library.substring.
Parameter endIndex only controls the slice performed by Library.substring.
Parameter thisTraitCount is the modulo bound used inside traitGenerator.
Parameter traitProbability only selects the rarity branch of traitGenerator.
Parameter user of jagRandomizer is only forwarded into random().
Parameter jagID of jagRandomizer only drives branching and jagIDToHash indexing.
Parameter user is only consumed by the random() seed expression.
Parameter jagID is only consumed by the random() seed expression.
Parameter _inputLetter is only compared against LETTERS in letterToNumber.
Parameter jagID is the selector of the URI generation branches.
Parameter jagWeight is only embedded into the returned metadata.
Parameter leg1 is only stored into Leg[0] by setJagLegendary.
Parameter ecozAddress is only cast and stored into ecozContract.
Parameter newOwner is only passed to _setOwner by transferOwnership.
Parameter _traitTypeIndex only selects the traitTypes key written by addJagTraitType.
Parameter traits is only iterated and pushed into traitTypes storage.
Parameter index only selects the traitTypes key deleted by clearTraitType.
Local thisTrait is the temporary result computed inside traitGenerator.
Local rand is the temporary random() result used inside jagRandomizer.
Local thisTraitIndex is a temporary index used inside jaguarTokenURI.
Local encodedLen is a temporary length used inside Base64.encode and its assembly block.
